eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Nevada, CA; at 5:17 PM on AUG 25, 2021 Effective until 10:17 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: From the Nevada County Office of Emergency Services. The Grass Valley Police Department has issued an Evacuation ORDER for a Wildfire affecting zones GRS-E280, GRS-E222, and GRS-E380. EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY.  Zones GRS-E381 and GRS-E250 are under SHELTER IN PLACE. NU High School will be a Temporary Evacuation Point. Info at: Community.Zonehaven.com.
